title: Vagabond
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A fictionalized life of the swordsman Miyamoto Musashi, based on Eiji Yoshikawa's novel Musashi. After the Battle of Sekigahara, the wild youth Takezo vows to become 'invincible under the heavens', is renamed Musashi by the monk Takuan, and wanders Japan dueling rivals while slowly questioning what strength means.
life_message: It holds up a long inner journey from violent striving toward understanding, calm and connection with others.
